blocks.html: Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center plays host to newly-opened Member’s Services branch of PAG-IBIG Fund (Home Development Mutual Fund or HDMF) located at the 2nd level area of Robinsons Place Las Pinas. This is the 1st Pag Ibig Fund branch to open in Robinsons Malls. Residents of Las Piñas can now avail front line services of this Agency, comprising of Membership Registration (including online), Claiming of their Member’s Identification and Member’s Data Form, request and verify employee statement of accumulated value (ESAV), inquire on housing loans. Other services that will be available soon includes collection/payment acceptance and loyalty card data issuance. Present during the ribbon cutting ceremony and blessing are Amado Dizon, Officer in Charge Senior Vice President. Member Services Operations; Mylene A. Del Rosario, Regional Operations Manager of Robinsons Forum, Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Las Pinas; Tess Miranda Special Projects Manager Property Management Group; Irving L. Wu, Operations Director for Luzon Malls, Robinsons Land Corporation; Acmad Rizaldi P. Moti, Officer in Charge – Chief Executive Officer, PAG-IBIG Fund; Alexander Hilario G. Aguilar, Officer in Charge – DCEO , Member Services Operations Cluster and Sylvia Vista, Area Head Member Service Operations West Area. Citizens can look forward to ten (10) Member’s Services Branch to open at Robinsons Malls and next in line is Robinsons Place Iligan. Pag-ibig Fund is open from 11:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Mondays to Fridays. Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center is a public service program of Robinsons Land Corporation. It is the Philippines’ first and biggest shopping center facility that brings together all the government agencies most relevant to the communities where Robinsons Malls are located. At present, there are 18 participating government agencies which are Bureau of Immigration (BI), Commission on Elections (COMELEC), Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), Department of Trade & Industry (DTI), Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), Land Registration Authority (LRA), Land Transportation Office (LTO), National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), Philippine Health Insurance (PHILHEALTH), Philippine Postal Corporation (PHLPost), Home Development Mutual Fund (Pag-IBIG Fund); Government Service Insurance System (GSIS)), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Social Security System (SSS), Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA), Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Authority (TIEZA); Philippine Overseas Employment Administration (POEA); and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA). There are 33 Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Centers nationwide with 6 more soon to open in Iligan, Naga, Tuguegarao, North Tacloban, Valencia and Ormoc
